propositions: ADD and REMOVE link emission must use the same effective link_map resolver to ensure consistent mapping of rebar relations to Jira link types
Skip overrides must suppress both ADD and REMOVE symmetrically; a skipped relation is never added, never removed, and never approximated
REMOVE attribution must be config-aware so that a remote link carrying an overridden vendor type is recovered via the inverted map, not spuriously dropped or adopted
Undeclared link types must fail closed via validation against a declared link_types vocabulary, raising MappingConfigError before mutation
Override link types replace only the Jira vendor type while preserving the built-in swap boolean; absence of override falls back to built-in mapping
Built-in backends at jira/backend.py:323 and jira_datacenter/backend.py:527 must both route through the single effective_link_map seam with no behavior change when no mapping block is present
